question: Evaluate $\begin{vmatrix} 2 & 7 & 3 \\ 5 & 2 & 6 \\ 1 & 4 & 3 \end{vmatrix}$ using cofactor expansion along the first row.
explanation:
Let $\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} 2 & 7 & 3 \\ 5 & 2 & 6 \\ 1 & 4 & 3 \end{vmatrix}$
expand along row 1:
$= 2\begin{vmatrix}2 & 6 \\ 4 & 3\end{vmatrix} - 7\begin{vmatrix}5 & 6 \\ 1 & 3\end{vmatrix} + 3\begin{vmatrix}5 & 2 \\ 1 & 4\end{vmatrix}$

First minor: $2\times3 - 6\times4 = 6 - 24 = -18$
Second minor: $5\times3 - 6\times1 = 15 - 6 = 9$
Third minor: $5\times4 - 2\times1 = 20 - 2 = 18$

So,
$= 2\times(-18) - 7\times9 + 3\times18$
$= -36 - 63 + 54$
$= (-99) + 54 = -45$

$\boxed{-45}$
